meta.title: Role team
meta.description: Adds four model-routed agents that work as one team: PLAN writes a rigorous plan (steps with exact file paths, risks, verification commands, acceptance checks), the ADVISOR audits the plan itself before WORKER starts and revises rejected plans, WORKER implements in the shared workspace, ADVISOR audits every attempt from a different model family, and REVIEWER is the final gate whose approval is the only approved outcome. When the rounds run out without approval, the run asks the user how to proceed: continue without approval, try three more rounds, change the worker model (with a model choice), or stop. roles_run drives the loop; role_plan, role_worker, role_advisor and role_reviewer run a single role; /role-plan <task or plan.md> runs the whole pipeline on a task or a Markdown plan file (for example a Jev plan artifact). Settings → Models gains a Role team section with the current model for each role, a provider/model picker over the live adapter catalogue, reasoning-effort selection, per-role reset, and independence warnings; /roles offers the same routes from chat. In the chat timeline, role tool calls render as dedicated cards with role badges, each stage's provider/model route, live progress of the active role, and the explicit ADVISOR/REVIEWER comments; the structured results are also inspectable in the Trajectory view. Role children are fresh agents with the session's tools and permission policy.
